evidence.label: mcp-npm-install-script (medium/low)
evidence.detail: Listed, not deducted: this check is new and its precision has not been measured, so it is shown for review and scores nothing. This package.json declares an npm `postinstall` script, which npm runs automatically when the package is installed — for an MCP server started with npx, before any client has run it. Install scripts are how several npm supply-chain compromises executed, and also how many packages build native code; the command is in the excerpt.
